//: MCP servers this template ships. Deliberately SHORT. Claude Code already has file, bash, git and web tools, so Filesystem/Git/Fetch MCP servers would only duplicate them and spend context. A server earns a line here by doing something the built-ins cannot. Add your own with `claude mcp add`; the MCP check verifies whatever is declared. See docs/mcp.md for the opt-in list, what each one costs, and what is deliberately not shipped.

context7.//: Live, version-correct library docs. This is the one server the harness genuinely needs: every skill with a non-empty `libraries:` list owes a Skill Freshness Check, and answering 'what changed in v6?' from training data is exactly the stale-knowledge failure that check exists to catch.

playwright.//: Drives a real browser. This template already ships Playwright e2e tests and captures screenshots for the vision-judge, so the agent being able to open the page it just built closes that loop instead of guessing from the DOM.

design-notes.//: Design reference corpus. Grounds /write-design decisions in something citable instead of whatever the author remembered. Ships with a default corpus covering authorization, idempotency, failure handling, data retention and rate limiting; point RIGEL_NOTES_PATH at your own markdown notes to use those instead. Needs no key, no account and no network.
